title: Streak-free glass cleaner
subtitle: A fast-drying spray for windows, mirrors, and glass splashbacks
excerpt: Streak-free glass cleaner is a dilute solution of white vinegar, isopropyl alcohol, and distilled water mixed in a spray bottle. It evaporates fast and leaves no residue on windows, mirrors, and glass splashbacks. Makes 500 ml per batch; keeps indefinitely at room temperature.
sourceNotes: Isopropyl alcohol and vinegar glass cleaner: Natural Cleaning Solutions by Rachel Ogden (2012). The fast evaporation of isopropyl alcohol is what prevents streaking, the alcohol displaces the water before it can leave mineral deposits. Vinegar cuts grease and fingerprints; distilled water prevents hard-water spots. Do not use on anti-reflective coatings (camera lenses, AR-coated eyeglasses, monitor screens), the alcohol can damage these.

recipe.batchNotes: Scale up and refill the spray bottle as needed.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Ready to use immediately. Does not improve with resting.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: Effectively indefinite, both isopropyl alcohol and vinegar are self-preserving and stable at room temperature. Store in a dark bottle to protect the isopropyl alcohol from UV degradation.

glossaryTerms.definition: A fast-evaporating alcohol used in cleaning products. It displaces water on glass surfaces before the water can leave mineral deposits, which is why alcohol-based glass cleaners dry without streaks. Available as 70% or 99% solutions, use 70% for glass cleaning.

, and distilled water. It evaporates quickly and leaves no residue on windows, mirrors, and glass splashbacks. Makes 500 ml; keeps indefinitely at room temperature.

items.prepNote: 70% isopropyl alcohol; the fast-evaporating agent that prevents streaking
distilled white vinegar; cuts grease and fingerprints
distilled (not tap) water; tap water contains minerals that cause spots on glass

content.text: Combine all three ingredients in the spray bottle. No mixing is required, the liquids blend on shaking.

Spray onto the glass surface and wipe immediately with a lint-free cloth or scrunched newspaper, the newspaper method is well known for leaving no fibres. Wipe in S-strokes from top to bottom. The alcohol evaporates within seconds, taking the water with it. On heavily soiled glass, wipe once with a damp cloth to remove the main soil before applying the cleaner for the final streak-free pass.
Avoid anti-reflective coatings on spectacle lenses, laptop screens, and camera glass. Also avoid natural stone surfaces such as marble and limestone, where the vinegar etches the finish.
Keeps indefinitely at room temperature. Store in a dark or opaque bottle out of direct sunlight.
